---
title: "Model Responses"
---

Model outputs for all three conditions, scored by **Prometheus 2** (7B v2.0). Use the tables below to search and filter; expand a row to compare conditions on the same prompt.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from data_loader import (
    CONDITION_LABELS,
    EVALS_DIR,
    TEST_LABELS,
    format_score,
    load_jsonl,
    show_table,
    truncate,
)

judged_dir = EVALS_DIR / "judged"

all_rows = []
for condition in ("A", "B", "C"):
    for row in load_jsonl(judged_dir / f"condition_{condition}.jsonl"):
        all_rows.append(
            {
                "ID": row["id"],
                "Condition": f"{condition} ({CONDITION_LABELS[condition]})",
                "Test": TEST_LABELS.get(row["test"], row["test"]),
                "Trait": row.get("trait", ""),
                "Score": format_score(row.get("score")),
                "Pair score": format_score(row.get("pair_invariance_score")),
                "Prompt": truncate(row.get("prompt", ""), 180),
                "Response": truncate(row.get("response", ""), 220),
            }
        )

df = pd.DataFrame(all_rows)
```

## Consistency scores by condition

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
consistency = df[df["Trait"].eq("consistency")].copy()
consistency_pivot = (
    consistency.groupby(["ID", "Condition"], as_index=False)["Score"]
    .first()
    .pivot(index="ID", columns="Condition", values="Score")
    .reset_index()
)
consistency_pivot.columns.name = None
show_table(consistency_pivot, page_length=15)
```

## Sample side-by-side comparison

Full text for one consistency item across all three conditions:

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
sample_id = next(
    row["id"]
    for row in load_jsonl(judged_dir / "condition_A.jsonl")
    if row.get("trait") == "consistency"
)

by_condition = {}
for condition in ("A", "B", "C"):
    for row in load_jsonl(judged_dir / f"condition_{condition}.jsonl"):
        if row["id"] == sample_id:
            by_condition[condition] = row
            break

print(f"**Item:** `{sample_id}` · **Trait:** consistency\n")

for condition in ("A", "B", "C"):
    row = by_condition[condition]
    score = format_score(row.get("score")) or "—"
    print(f"### Condition {condition} ({CONDITION_LABELS[condition]}) — score {score}\n")
    print(f"**Probe prompt:** {row.get('prompt', '')}\n")
    if row.get("conversation"):
        print("**Conversation:**")
        for turn in row["conversation"]:
            role = turn.get("role", "unknown").title()
            content = turn.get("content", "")
            print(f"- **{role}:** {content[:400]}{'…' if len(content) > 400 else ''}")
        print()
    print(f"**Final response:**\n\n{row.get('response', '')}\n")
    if row.get("feedback"):
        print(f"*Judge feedback:* {truncate(row['feedback'], 400)}\n")
    print("---\n")
```

## Score distributions

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plot_df = df[df["Score"].astype(str).str.len() > 0].copy()
plot_df["Score"] = plot_df["Score"].astype(float)
plot_df["Cond"] = plot_df["Condition"].str[0]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 3.5), sharey=True)
traits = ["capability", "jailbreak_robustness", "consistency"]
titles = ["Capability", "Jailbreak", "Consistency"]

for ax, trait, title in zip(axes, traits, titles):
    subset = plot_df[plot_df["Trait"].eq(trait)]
    means = subset.groupby("Cond")["Score"].mean().reindex(["A", "B", "C"])
    colors = ["#2980b9", "#27ae60", "#c0392b"]
    ax.bar(means.index, means.values, color=colors, width=0.55)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("Condition")
    ax.set_ylim(1, 5)
    ax.set_ylabel("Mean score")

fig.suptitle("Mean Prometheus scores by condition", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
